title: What $3.7 million in 30 years buys today
made_by: 엔진/find.py 2026-11-04 · 신호 ['s0f1b792b', 's1e97ccb1'] · 퍼스나 The late starter

fact.thing: today's value of $3.7 million 30 years from now, assuming 2% yearly inflation
fact.claim: If prices rise 2% a year, which is the Bank of Canada's inflation target, $3.7 million 30 years from now buys about what $2.04 million buys today ($3,700,000 ÷ 1.02^30 ≈ $2,042,660). The 2% figure is the Bank's target. It is not a forecast or a promise, and actual inflation can run higher or lower. The Bank's October 2026 report projects inflation around 3% through much of 2027, and at 3% the same goal is worth less than this in today's dollars.

plain.so_what: The $3.7 million on your plan is money in future dollars, and in today's money it is worth about $1.66 million less than it sounds.
plain.do: Write down the goal number on your plan and how many years until you need it.
